tldr_zh: Claude新增浮水印、Mac遭攻擊、SpaceX收購Cursor，科技安全問題凸顯
tldr_en: Claude watermarks launched, Mac vulnerability exploited, SpaceX closes Cursor acquisition

items.title_en: Anthropic Shares Details About Claude's New Watermarks
items.summary_zh: Anthropic公開了Claude AI模型新增的浮水印功能如何運作的更多細節。浮水印技術旨在標識AI生成的內容，幫助識別機器生成的文本，但仍有疑問涉及編輯隱藏及對代碼的影響。
items.summary_en: Anthropic revealed more details about how Claude's new watermarking system works to identify AI-generated content. The technology aims to mark machine-generated text while raising questions about editing susceptibility and code implications.

items.title_zh: Mac遠端存取漏洞遭主動利用，駭客可無密碼登入
items.title_en: Vulnerability Giving Attackers Full Control of Macs Is Under Active Exploitation
items.summary_zh: 一個影響macOS的遠端存取漏洞正在被主動利用，駭客利用螢幕分享功能可繞過密碼驗證獲得完全控制權。該漏洞威脅重大，用戶應立即更新系統補丁以防止未授權存取。
items.summary_en: A critical macOS vulnerability allowing remote attackers full system control without a password is being actively exploited. The screen-sharing bug enables unauthorized access, and users should urgently apply security patches.

items.title_zh: SpaceX正式完成對AI編碼新創Cursor的收購
items.title_en: SpaceX Officially Closes Its Cursor Acquisition
items.summary_zh: SpaceX已正式完成對AI編碼工具新創公司Cursor的收購。此舉標誌著SpaceX在AI軟體工具領域的擴張，Cursor是一個受歡迎的AI輔助編碼平台。
items.summary_en: SpaceX has officially closed its acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor. The deal marks SpaceX's expansion into AI-powered software development tools, with Cursor being a popular AI-assisted coding platform.

items.title_zh: WordPress核心漏洞XSS2Shell致逾萬網站遭鎖定
items.title_en: WordPress XSS2Shell Vulnerability Affects Over 10,000 Websites
items.summary_zh: WordPress發布7.0.3安全更新，修補核心登入頁面的高風險跨站指令碼漏洞CVE-2026-64638。攻擊者無需先取得帳號即可觸發漏洞，若誘使管理員操作惡意頁面，可擴大至PHP代碼執行，導致超過萬個網站遭自動化鎖定。
items.summary_en: WordPress released version 7.0.3 to patch a critical XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-64638) in the login page. Attackers can trigger the flaw without credentials and escalate to PHP code execution if administrators interact with malicious pages, affecting over 10,000 sites.

items.title_zh: 自駕卡車正式開始在加州高速公路測試
items.title_en: Self-Driving Trucks Officially Testing on California Highways
items.summary_zh: Aurora Innovation和Kodiak AI兩家自駕卡車公司已獲得加州交通管理局許可，開始在加州高速公路上進行官方測試。這標誌著自駕重型車輛商業化的重要進展。
items.summary_en: Aurora Innovation and Kodiak AI have received permits from California's Department of Motor Vehicles to officially test self-driving trucks on state highways. This represents significant progress toward commercial autonomous trucking deployment.

items.title_zh: Grok工具遭濫用製作非法兒童影像
items.title_en: Woman Claims Grok Used to Transform Childhood Photo Into Explicit Imagery
items.summary_zh: 一名女性聲稱她的繼父利用Grok AI工具將她的童年照片轉換為明確的性虐待影像。該事件凸顯AI工具被濫用於製作非法內容的風險，引發對平台安全措施的質疑。
items.summary_en: A woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform her childhood photo into explicit imagery. The incident highlights serious risks of AI tools being misused to create child sexual abuse material and raises concerns about platform safeguards.

items.title_zh: 印尼強震增至47人罹難，救援隊持續搜救
items.title_en: Indonesia Earthquake Death Toll Rises to 47, Rescue Efforts Continue
items.summary_zh: 印尼東部佛羅雷斯島外海發生規模7.7強震，罹難人數已增至47人，數百棟建築物被毀。救援人員持續在瓦礫堆中搜尋生還者，官方正進行災害評估。
items.summary_en: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Indonesia's Flores Island, killing 47 people and destroying hundreds of buildings. Rescue teams continue searching for survivors among the rubble as officials assess the damage.

items.title_zh: 美國維州立大學發生槍擊事件，5人受傷
items.title_en: Five Shot at Virginia State University, Multiple Suspects at Large
items.summary_zh: 美國維吉尼亞州立大學凌晨發生槍擊事件，5人受傷，警方在宿舍外的事件現場進行調查。目前尚無人被捕，警方仍在追捕多名嫌犯。
items.summary_en: Multiple gunshots fired outside residence halls at Virginia State University early Saturday injured five people. Police continue investigating with no arrests made as authorities pursue several suspects.

items.title_zh: 夏威夷面臨34年首次颶風直擊威脅
items.title_en: Hawaii Braces for First Direct Hurricane Hit in 34 Years
items.summary_zh: 一級颶風拉拉（Lala）正朝夏威夷逼近，可能造成該州34年來首次颶風直擊。最壞情況下可能在大島帶來高達25英寸的雨量，當地已進入緊急應變狀態。
items.summary_en: Category 1 Hurricane Lala threatens Hawaii with its first direct hurricane hit in 34 years. In worst-case scenarios, the Big Island could receive up to 25 inches of rainfall as the state prepares emergency response measures.

items.title_zh: 以色列轟炸黎巴嫩11人死亡，稱擊斃真主黨指揮官
items.title_en: Israeli Strikes on Lebanon Kill Eleven, Claim Hezbollah Commander Killed
items.summary_zh: 以色列軍隊對黎巴嫩發動空襲，聲稱打擊真主黨恐怖基礎設施，導致11人死亡。以色列表示擊斃一名真主黨指揮官，希望與黎巴嫩透過美國斡旋展開更認真的談判。
items.summary_en: Israeli airstrikes on Lebanon targeting Hezbollah infrastructure killed eleven people, with Israeli officials claiming they eliminated a Hezbollah commander. Israel expressed hope for more serious US-mediated talks with Lebanon.
